# Living Lab Nigeria 2026

**Description**: Living Lab Nigeria 2026 is an exclusive, immersive dermatological event and scientific conference hosted by La Roche-Posay (L'Oréal).
**Location**: Lagos, Nigeria
**Dates**: 3rd November - 5th November 2026
**Audience**: Exclusively for verified dermatologists, medical professionals, and certified clinical skincare experts.

## Key Features
- **The Lab Routes**: Six stages of dermatological discovery including Discover, Test, Experience, Learn, Consult, and Leave with your skin story.
- **Science**: Deep dives into proprietary La Roche-Posay innovations including Melasyl and Mexoryl 400.
- **Speakers**: World-class clinical experts and pioneers in dermatology.

## Registration
Registration is strictly limited to verified medical professionals. Registration can be completed via the official website by providing professional credentials (Medical ID, Practice Name).

## Contact
For general inquiries, reach out to contact@laroche-posay.ng. 
For legal inquiries, reach out to legal@laroche-posay.ng.
